$comment: Ratchet baseline for check-email-send-gated.mjs. Each key is an UNGATED sendEmail/sendBatchEmails call site (<file>:<line>) that is NOT preceded by an isSuppressed()/isSuppressedByEmail() check in its function. The list may only SHRINK. To clear an entry: gate the send and remove the line, then run node scripts/check-email-send-gated.mjs --write. NEVER add a new entry to silence a new lead send, gate it instead. kind=internal: a genuinely-internal or 1:1 transactional send (broker alert, admin notice, the broker's own digest, an e-signature notification to a transaction party) with no marketable lead recipient to suppress; permanently allowlisted. kind=lead-todo is NO LONGER ALLOWED: every lead/client-facing marketing send is now gated through the suppression chokepoint, and the runner asserts only kind=internal entries remain.

app/api/cma/[slug]/gmail-draft/route.ts:.reason: Internal: Resend fallback to the BROKER (impersonateAs) when the Gmail draft cannot be created. Never to the lead. The lead recipient is gated by isSuppressedByEmail earlier in handleDraft before any draft/fallback runs.

app/api/cron/daily-broker-digest/route.t.reason: Internal: one digest email per BROKER (Matt/Rebecca/Paul), not a lead. No consent record applies; permanently allowlisted.

app/api/cron/marketing-optimization-repo.reason: Internal: weekly marketing-optimization report to the brokerage's own inbox, not a lead. Permanently allowlisted.

app/api/cron/weekly-pipeline-digest/rout.reason: Internal: weekly pipeline digest to the broker, not a lead. Permanently allowlisted.

app/home-valuation/actions.ts:178.reason: Internal: new-lead notification to ADMIN_EMAIL (the brokerage), not the lead. The two LEAD-facing sends in this action (auto-CMA + acknowledgment) are gated by isSuppressedByEmail. Permanently allowlisted.

lib/cma-deliver.ts:353.reason: Internal: Resend fallback to the BROKER when the Gmail draft fails (preserves the human-review gate). Never to the lead. The lead is gated by isSuppressed/isSuppressedByEmail earlier in finalizeAndDeliverCma.

lib/cma-deliver.ts:412.reason: Internal: notifies Matt (MATT_ALERT_EMAIL) that a CMA is ready for review, not the client. Permanently allowlisted.

lib/cma-delivery.ts:373.reason: Internal: broker-review notification to the assigned broker's email with a signed preview link. processCmaDelivery only builds to 'ready'; it never emails the lead. The lead delivery happens in the gated /api/cma-drafts/[id]/send route and contact-cma.ts.

lib/cma-request.ts:409.reason: Internal: new-CMA-request notification to the assigned broker (sendBrokerNotification), not the lead. The lead confirmation (sendLeadConfirmation) is gated by isSuppressedByEmail.

lib/expired-alert.ts:108.reason: Internal: expired-listing alert to Matt's inbox (MATT_ALERT_EMAIL), not the homeowner. Permanently allowlisted.

lib/fsbo-alert.ts:113.reason: Internal: FSBO alert to Matt's inbox (MATT_ALERT_EMAIL), not the homeowner. Permanently allowlisted.

lib/marketing-brain/daily-digest.ts:123.reason: Internal: marketing-brain daily digest to Matt's inbox (MATT_ALERT_EMAIL), not a lead. Permanently allowlisted.

lib/seller-lead-alert.ts:109.reason: Internal: new seller-lead alert to Matt's inbox (MATT_ALERT_EMAIL), not the lead. Permanently allowlisted.

lib/tc/signing-emails.ts:102.reason: 1:1 transactional: signing-progress / completion notice to a transaction party for one specific envelope they are a signer/broker on. CAN-SPAM transactional-message exemption; consent established by being a signing party (ESIGN/Oregon UETA). Not a marketing send.

lib/tc/signing-emails.ts:53.reason: 1:1 transactional: e-signature request to a specific signer for one specific envelope and property. CAN-SPAM transactional-message exemption; the recipient is a named party to the transaction. Not a marketing send.

lib/tc/signing-emails.ts:77.reason: 1:1 transactional: completed-and-signed copy (sealed PDF + certificate) to a transaction party for one specific envelope. CAN-SPAM transactional-message exemption. Not a marketing send.
